summary_en: ¥1,900/share tender offer (30 business days: 13 Jul – 25 Aug 2026) for minimum 3,845,584 shares (42.0% of shares outstanding). Offeror Orsay Corp., wholly owned by Nozawa Katsumi (Art Vivant CEO; currently holds 2.61% directly; Katsucorporation holds 33.76%). Prior MBO attempt at ¥1,670 failed (Sep–Oct 2025). Board recommends shareholders tender. Delisting intended.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation of Tender Offer
translation_en_brief: On 10 July 2026, Art Vivant's board approved an MBO tender offer by Orsay Corp., a vehicle wholly owned by Nozawa Katsumi (the company's CEO and 2.61% shareholder). Orsay will offer ¥1,900 per share for a minimum of 3,845,584 shares (42.0% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), with the 30 business-day window running 13 July to 25 August 2026. Upon receipt of the minimum, Orsay's ownership (including that of Katsucorporation, Nozawa's asset-management company holding 33.76%) would reach 78.45%. The offer aims to take the company private; delisting is intended. The board recommendation follows affirmative advice from independent directors and no objection from independent auditors. A prior MBO attempt at ¥1,670 (Sep–Oct 2025) failed to meet its 2.99M-share minimum, collecting only 1.95M tenders. This new offer at the higher price is a second attempt at the same delisting objective.
